title: Technical Writer
description:
**Job Title- Associate - Technical Writer**

**Total Exp - 4 – 8 Years**

**Location- Pune**

**Work Mode- Work From Office**

**Job Description**

* Develop and Maintain Documentation: Research, plan, write, edit, and publish a variety of technical content, user guides and manuals, online help systems/knowledge base articles, tutorials and how-to guides, release notes, and installation procedures
* Simplify Complex Concepts: Translate highly technical information and specifications into clear, easily consumable content for both technical and nontechnical end-users.
* Collaborate with Subject Experts: Work closely with engineers, team leads, managers, and support teams to gather information, understand product features, and ensure technical accuracy.
* Ensure Quality and Consistency: Edit, proofread, and standardize content for clarity, consistency, tone, and adherence to our style guide and company standards.
* Manage Documentation Lifecycle: Own the documentation lifecycle, including content architecture, version control, and content auditing for regular updates and retirement.
* Incorporate Visuals: Work with engineers or use screen-capture tools to integrate graphics, screenshots, and diagrams to enhance user understanding.
* Draft and publish announcements: Create and distribute announcements and release updates to communicate system changes, maintenance activities, or new feature rollouts.

What You’ll Need…

* Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in English, Communications, Computer Science, or a related field, with equivalent experience considered.
* 3–4 years of proven experience as a Technical Writer, Technical Communicator, or in a similar role, preferably within the IT industry.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to adapt content for diverse audiences.
* Strong aptitude for quickly grasping complex technical concepts and presenting them in a clear, concise, and user-friendly manner.
* Excellent attention to detail, coupled with strong organizational and time management skills to manage multiple projects effectively.
* Solid understanding of technical domains such as Linux, networking, and IT infrastructure.
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and IT infrastructure operations.
* Flexibility to work in shifts within a 24/7 operational environment.

Pay: ₹249,000.00 - ₹800,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience do you have?
* How many years of experience do you have in Technical Writing?
* What is your Current CTC?
* What is your Expected CTC?
* What is your Notice Period? If Serving, mention your LWD.
* What is your Current Location?

Work Location: In person

title: Import Export Documentation Executive
description:
Company Location : HADAPSAR , Pune

Designation : Logistic/Sales coordinator.

Experience :- 6+ years

About the Role

Key Responsibilities

Prepare and share quotations, proforma invoices, and sales contracts with customers.

Coordinate with customers and internal teams for order confirmation and follow-ups.

Process customer orders and monitor order status and delivery timelines.

Work closely with production and logistics teams to ensure timely shipment of orders.

Prepare and verify export and shipping documentation (Commercial Invoice, Packing List, BL, COO, COA, etc.).

Coordinate for Bill of Lading draft approval and shipment documentation.

Maintain accurate sales records, order tracking, and shipment reports.

Provide regular updates to customers regarding order and delivery status.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain, or a related field.

2–5 years of experience in sales coordination, order processing, or logistics operations.

Knowledge of ERP/SAP systems will be an advantage.

Strong communication and coordination skills.

Proficiency in MS Excel and documentation management.

Ability to handle multiple tasks and meet deadlines.

Preferred Skills

Sales Coordination

Logistics & Shipment Documentation

Customer Relationship Management

Order Processing & Tracking

Reporting and Data Management

Pay: ₹65,000.00 - ₹78,000.00 per month

title: Engineer/Senior Engineer - Technical Documentation
description:
**Your role**
-------------

We are seeking a **Technical Documentation Engineer** to support service excellence through the development, maintenance and continuous improvement of Field Service Standard Operating Procedures and related technical documentation.The role will focus on the **Field service SOP** and related technical documentation activities at Business Area level.

The ideal candidate to translate practical field-service knowledge into clear, accurate and user-focused technical documentation while working effectively with cross-functional stakeholders.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Create, update and maintain **Field Service SOPs (FSSOPs)** and other technical documentation using appropriate authoring tools.
* Translate field-service practices, engineering information and product knowledge into **clear and executable service procedures**.
* Collect, evaluate and validate technical inputs including **3D models, BOMs, service data and product information**.
* Collaborate with **Product Engineering, Service, Product Management, Business Areas and external vendors** to resolve technical queries and ensure completeness of inputs.
* Develop strong knowledge of **vacuum products, service processes, configurations and field-service requirements**.
* Plan and prioritize multiple requests based on **customer requirements, business priorities and committed delivery dates**.
* Execute FSSOP activities according to **Atlas Copco group standards, work instructions, checklists and quality requirements**.
* Review documentation for **technical accuracy, completeness, usability and consistency**.
* Track job requests and ensure adherence to **lead time, quality and delivery commitments**.
* Coordinate with customers and stakeholders to collect inputs, clarify requirements, provide status updates and incorporate feedback.
* Support **Product Database requests** and related Business Area activities.
* Identify opportunities to improve **documentation quality, processes, productivity and turnaround time**.
* Coordinate and control work delivered by **external agencies**, both onsite and offshore.
* Support unanticipated technical documentation requirements and project deliverables.
* Explore and apply **AI and automation** to improve existing documentation workflows and productivity.

**To succeed, you will need**
-----------------------------

**What we are looking for**

* **2-3 years of experience** in field service, service engineering, technical documentation or a related engineering function.
* Experience in the **vacuum business / vacuum equipment / industrial machinery** is highly desirable.
* Practical understanding of **field-service activities, maintenance procedures and troubleshooting**.
* Diploma/Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent technical qualification.
* Ability to understand **engineering drawings, BOMs, 3D models and technical specifications**.
* Strong technical writing, analytical and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining **quality and delivery commitments**.
* Experience with technical authoring tools, PLM/ERP or product databases is an advantage.
* Exposure to **AI, automation or digital documentation solutions** is an added advantage.

**In return, we offer**
-----------------------

* Ample of opportunities for professional development
* New challenges and opportunities to learn every day
* A culture known for respectful interaction, ethical behaviour, and integrity
* Drive your Career, Explore Opportunities, Realize your Passion.
* Together we build a culture where difference is valued, and we share a deep sense of purpose and belonging.

**Job location**
----------------

Hybrid
  
This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on-site at Pune.
